mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.MEMBER_ID, P.UNIV_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, P.DESCRIPTION, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.IS_DELETED, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, P.PLACE, P.CATEGORY, M.MEMBER_NAME AS SELLER_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS SELLER_NICKNAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_LIKE PL WHERE PL.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM TC WHERE TC.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS CHAT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS REPORT_COUNT, 0 AS HAS_UNREAD_TRADE_CHAT, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REPORT PR WHERE PR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_BLIND FROM PRODUCT P JOIN MEMBER M ON P.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_ID, MEMBER_ID, UNIV_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_STATUS, PLACE, CATEGORY, VIEW_COUNT, IS_DELETED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{memberId}, #{univId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{productStatus}, 'SALE'), #{place}, #{category}, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName}, PRICE = #{price}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PLACE = #{place}, CATEGORY = #{category}, PRODUCT_STATUS = #{productStatus}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
UPDATE PRODUCT SET IS_DELETED = 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGE ( IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_SORT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT_IMAGE.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageSort}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_ID AS imageId, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, IMAGE_SORT AS imageSort, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY IMAGE_SORT ASC

SELECT PC.COMMENT_ID, PC.MEMBER_ID, PC.PRODUCT_ID, PC.UNIV_ID, PC.PARENT_ID, PC.CONTENT, PC.IS_ANONYMOUS, PC.IS_DELETED, PC.CREATED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, 0 AS LIKE_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_COMMENT PC JOIN MEMBER M ON PC.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND PC.PARENT_ID IS NULL AND PC.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY PC.CREATED_AT ASC

SELECT PC.COMMENT_ID, PC.MEMBER_ID, PC.PRODUCT_ID, PC.UNIV_ID, PC.PARENT_ID, PC.CONTENT, PC.IS_ANONYMOUS, PC.IS_DELETED, PC.CREATED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, 0 AS LIKE_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_COMMENT PC JOIN MEMBER M ON PC.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE PC.COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND PC.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT PC.COMMENT_ID, PC.MEMBER_ID, PC.PRODUCT_ID, PC.UNIV_ID, PC.PARENT_ID, PC.CONTENT, PC.IS_ANONYMOUS, PC.IS_DELETED, PC.CREATED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, 0 AS LIKE_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_COMMENT PC JOIN MEMBER M ON PC.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE PC.PARENT_ID = #{parentId} AND PC.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY PC.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_COMMENT ( COMMENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, UNIV_ID, PARENT_ID, CONTENT, IS_ANONYMOUS, IS_DELETED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT_COMMENT.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{univId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{isAnonymous}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_LIKE ( LIKE_ID, MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRESSED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT_LIKE.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{productId}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_REPORT ( REPORT_ID, MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REASON, DETAIL, PRESSED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT_REPORT.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, SYSTIMESTAMP )

SELECT SEQ_TRADE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRADE ( TRADE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, TRADE_STATUS, PRICE ) VALUES ( #{tradeId}, #{productId}, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, #{tradeStatus}, #{price} )

SELECT SEQ_PAYMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_ID, TRADE_ID, IMP_UID, MERCHANT_UID, AMOUNT, STATUS, PAID_AT ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{tradeId}, #{impUid}, #{merchantUid}, #{amount}, #{status}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PAID' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET PRODUCT_STATUS = #{productStatus}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.select: SELECT TCR.ROOM_ID, TCR.PRODUCT_ID, TCR.SELLER_ID, TCR.BUYER_ID, TCR.NEGOTIATED_PRICE, TCR.STATUS, TCR.CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, SM.MEMBER_NAME AS SELLER_NAME, BM.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE, ( SELECT M.SEND_AT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE UM WHERE UM.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID AND UM.SENDER_ID != #{buyerId} AND UM.IS_READ = 0 ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM TCR JOIN PRODUCT P ON TCR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN MEMBER SM ON TCR.SELLER_ID = SM.MEMBER_ID JOIN MEMBER BM ON TCR.BUYER_ID = BM.MEMBER_ID WHERE TCR.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND TCR.BUYER_ID = #{buyerId} AND TCR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TRADE_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRADE_CHAT_ROOM ( ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, NEGOTIATED_PRICE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{productId}, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, #{negotiatedPrice}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT TCR.ROOM_ID, TCR.PRODUCT_ID, TCR.SELLER_ID, TCR.BUYER_ID, TCR.NEGOTIATED_PRICE, TCR.STATUS, TCR.CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, SM.MEMBER_NAME AS SELLER_NAME, BM.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE, ( SELECT M.SEND_AT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE UM WHERE UM.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID AND UM.SENDER_ID != #{memberId} AND UM.IS_READ = 0 ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM TCR JOIN PRODUCT P ON TCR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN MEMBER SM ON TCR.SELLER_ID = SM.MEMBER_ID JOIN MEMBER BM ON TCR.BUYER_ID = BM.MEMBER_ID WHERE TCR.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND (TCR.SELLER_ID = #{memberId} OR TCR.BUYER_ID = #{memberId})

SELECT TCR.ROOM_ID, TCR.PRODUCT_ID, TCR.SELLER_ID, TCR.BUYER_ID, TCR.NEGOTIATED_PRICE, TCR.STATUS, TCR.CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, SM.MEMBER_NAME AS SELLER_NAME, BM.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE, ( SELECT M.SEND_AT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE UM WHERE UM.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID AND UM.SENDER_ID != #{memberId} AND UM.IS_READ = 0 ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM TCR JOIN PRODUCT P ON TCR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN MEMBER SM ON TCR.SELLER_ID = SM.MEMBER_ID JOIN MEMBER BM ON TCR.BUYER_ID = BM.MEMBER_ID WHERE (TCR.SELLER_ID = #{memberId} OR TCR.BUYER_ID = #{memberId}) AND TCR.STATUS != 'DELETED' ORDER BY COALESCE( ( SELECT MAX(M.SEND_AT) FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ), TCR.CREATED_AT ) DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM TCR JOIN TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE TCM ON TCM.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID WHERE TCR.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND (TCR.SELLER_ID = #{memberId} OR TCR.BUYER_ID = #{memberId}) AND TCM.SENDER_ID != #{memberId} AND TCM.IS_READ = 0

SELECT TCM.MESSAGE_ID, TCM.ROOM_ID, TCM.SENDER_ID, TCM.CONTENT, TCM.IS_READ, TCM.SEND_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS SENDER_NAME FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE TCM JOIN MEMBER M ON TCM.SENDER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE TCM.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY TCM.SEND_AT ASC

mapper.select: SELECT TCM.MESSAGE_ID, TCM.ROOM_ID, TCM.SENDER_ID, TCM.CONTENT, TCM.IS_READ, TCM.SEND_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS SENDER_NAME FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE TCM JOIN MEMBER M ON TCM.SENDER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE TCM.MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}

SELECT TCR.ROOM_ID, TCR.PRODUCT_ID, TCR.SELLER_ID, TCR.BUYER_ID, TCR.NEGOTIATED_PRICE, TCR.STATUS, TCR.CREATED_AT, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, SM.MEMBER_NAME AS SELLER_NAME, BM.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, ( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE, ( SELECT M.SEND_AT FROM TRADE_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = TCR.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.SEND_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM TCR JOIN PRODUCT P ON TCR.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN MEMBER SM ON TCR.SELLER_ID = SM.MEMBER_ID JOIN MEMBER BM ON TCR.BUYER_ID = BM.MEMBER_ID WHERE TCR.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND TCR.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
